tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ rta mgrin nag po yang gsang thugs kyi sgrub pa'i lo rgyus zab mo bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rta mgrin dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa: o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sambha wa de nyid bod yul gangs can gyi rgyal po: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa: mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis 'gro ba'i don du spyan drangs nas: brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du bzhugs su gsol te: zab chen gyi gdan bting: na bza' mthing nag dar gyi phu dung can rdo rje 'bar ba'i gsang lam sku la gsol: gser skyogs dang dngul skyogs su 'bras chang dang rgun 'brum gyi chang drangs: gser g.yu'i maṇḍal tshom bu dgu pa phul te: phyag mang du btsal nas zhus pa: kye gu ru chen po lags: khyed sku 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i sku mnga' ba: mtshan dang dpe byad gzi brjid lham mer gsal: gsung gi gsang sngags nus pas 'gro don mdzad: thugs mchog ma 'gags dus gsum sa ler gzigs: de phyir dus kyi tha mar sleb pa'i tshe: sa 'og sa steng klu dang rgyal pos khyab: gdon du klu dang rgyal bsen pho mo dar: nad du mdze lhog gzhan yang smyo 'bog mang: khyad par drang srong gza' yis gnod 'tshe byed: 'phral du btsog cing mthar thug sel dka' ba'i: mdze rigs bco brgyad dbyar gyi chu ltar brdol: de dag srung ba kun gyi mthar thug pa: bya sla tshegs chung don che gnang du gsol: zhes gsol bas: gu rus bka' bstsal pa:

kyai: lha sras byang chub sems dpa' snyan gsan 'tshal: kha ba can gyi rgyal khams ngan pa 'dir: mun pa'i smag dang 'dra ste 'dul bar dka': de phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i 'dul zhing yin: zhi bas ma thul gdug pa can rnams ni: 'phags pa rta mgrin rgyal por skur sprul nas: drag po sngags dang rdzas dang ting 'dzin gyis: 'dul bar nges kyi snyigs ma'i sems can rnams: chos rgyal mes dbon gsum gyis khrims bcas pa'i: dge bcu'i khrims bshig 'khrugs dpon dge bshes byed: byang sems dor nas kha drag btsun pa tshol: gnam la ltas ngan skar ma 'khrug cing shar: sa la 'khrul 'khor sa g.yos nad mang ldang: dam nyams khrims pas dge la kha drangs nas: dkor rdzas za zhing gtsug lag gnyan rnams 'joms: da lta'i bdud blon nag po drug gi las: smon lam sems bskyed ngan pas sde 'khrugs rtsom: de dus klu gdon gdug pa'i tshogs rnams dar: sa bdag klu 'di dug lnga'i gzhi las grub: lha srin sde brgyad kun dang bsdong zla byed: rdzu 'phrul sprul pa ma nges sna tshogs ston: chu brag sa dang shing rdo dag la gnas: legs nyes gang byas klu dang thug par 'gyur: 'gras pa sla zhing lkug pa'i rang bzhin gyis: dum par dka' la mdze lhog smyo 'bog dang: rims dug rgyal bsen drang srong nad kyis thebs: phyugs nad gor dang lhog gal rtse 'brum gtong:

de dus dbang chen drag po khro bo yis: 'dul bar mi 'gyur gang yang yod ma yin: de phyir 'di ni da lta dus bzang zhing: spyod pa bzang bas spel bar mi bya zhing: phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gter du sba bar byed: 'di ni rab tu gnyan cing mthu che bas: sgom bzlas gsal bas sde brgyad khong khrag 'byin: de phyir chu gtor gtor ma'i las la 'bad: gdug sems zhi nas phan sems 'byung bar 'gyur: myur tshad rlung 'dra rno tshad spu gri 'dra: me dang rtsi shing skam po 'phrad pa ltar: gdon bgegs sreg cing 'joms par the tshom med: sprin phung che yang rlung gis gtor ba ltar: kun nas rab tu nad gdon gnod pa sel: nyi ma shar bas mun pa rang sangs ltar: nad gdon sde brgyad gnod pa sel bar byed: ces so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bcom ldan 'das dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis: rgya gar shi len gong gi brag phug tu: bskyed rim gsal gdab dam sri nag po'i gdon: gnod sbyin nag po rang 'dra'i gzi brjid brtul: dam la btags nas gdug pa can rnams kyi: srog gi snying po sngags su byin gyis brlabs: lha dang sngags dang rdzas kyi them du bstan: de la phan bya gnod bya gnyis yin te: phan bya srung ba sngags rdzas ting nge 'dzin: gnod bya rabs gcod gtad dang gsum du 'dus: rgyal po chen po'i thugs la stims shig gsung:

rim par bris nas phyogs bzhi dbus lngar sbas: 'dra min rgyas bsdus mang yang gnad don gcig: 'di ni yang gsang snying po 'dus pa'i skor: dbu rtse rigs gsum ka ba'i khongs su sbas: dus la bab tshe rgyal po'i smon lam gyi: nges sprul gar gyi dbang phyug ye shes rtsal: de dang 'phrad nas 'gro ba'i don byed 'gyur: zhes gdams so: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: so phag shi thaṃ: dam med kyi lag tu shor na bskal pa 'jig go: ghu hya:
ces par gar gyi dbang phyug ye shes rol pa rtsal gyis bsam yas nas gdan drangs pa'o/// /

1$0000250dpal rta mgrin nag po thugs kyi sgrub pa bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ dbang chen nag po khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: gnod sbyin nag po dam la btags: dregs pa kun gyi srog snying bsdus: phyi rabs don du sgrub thabs brtsam: skyabs 'gro tshad med sems bskyed nas: thams cad stong pa'i ngang la bzhag: de nas sngags kyi rang sgra yis: chu la chu bur brdol ba ltar: dbang chen drag po'i sku ru bsam: ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐: stong nyid ngang las nam mkha'i khams: dmar nag me yi gur chen po: tsha zhing rtsub pa'i me 'od 'phro: de dbus nyon mongs 'chi bdag dang: phung po dang ni lha bu'i bdud: chung ma'i tshogs bcas bsnol ba'i steng: rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u rigs dang: dmangs rigs gdol pa sa bdag 'bum: gnyan chen sde bzhi brtsigs pa'i khar: nyi zla padma'i gdan stengs su: dran rig tsam las sku bskyed pa: bdag nyid rta mgrin nag po'i sku: sku yis khams gsum kun tu khyab: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa: sdang mig dmar zlum khrag mtshor 'khyil: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal gyi: mche gtsigs sma ra ag tshom 'bar: smin ma kham ser glog ltar 'khyug: lcags kyi ral pa spu gri'i so: sku rgyab rting sor khyab par 'phro: dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur ni: rngog ma le brgan me dpung 'bar:

phrum phrum dmar ser me stag 'phro: mig 'bur nyi zla'i gzi 'od 'bar: lhang lhang skad kyis srid gsum 'dul: phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i ral gri phyar: dgra bgegs mgo lus phye mar gcod: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags par bcas: dgra bgegs snying 'dren dbang po sdom: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs brkyang bskum bsgrad: sku stod zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: sku smad stag lpags sham thabs dkris: de steng dar nag ber chen gsol: thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: rgyal rigs sbrul dkar dbu la bcings: bram ze dmar pos snyan mgul mdzes: rje rigs ser khras phyag dpung brgyan: dmangs rigs ljang gus zhabs gdub dkris: gdol pa nag pos do shal 'phyang: mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcus brgyan: ral pa sprugs pa'i skra gseb nas: khro chung mang po char ltar 'beb: sku lus khro chung 'jigs pas gtams: de las 'khor lo ral gri dang: tho ba rdo rje mda' mdung gi: thog ser 'khrug cing gur du 'khyil: de las me dpung dmar nag gi: tshwa tshwa drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: rang byung rig pa nyid las shar: spyan 'dren dbang bskur bzhugs gsol dang: phyag mchod bstod pa kun spangs te: drag po sngags kyi bzlas pa bya: oṃ ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: yig 'bru bcu gcig rgyun du bzla: ting nge 'dzin gyis sems bsrung zhing: rta mgrin dpal gyi sku ru gyur: bzlas pa sngags kyis ngag bsrung zhing:

mthu stobs rten 'brel nus pa thob: rten 'brel rdzas kyis lus bsrung zhing: rno la ngar gyis btags pa ltar: srung dang zlog dang bsad pa 'grub: 'di la grangs dang tshad med cing: lan gcig bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang: khro bo kun gyi mthu stobs 'grub: rgyun du bzlas na smos ci dgos: padma 'byung gnas bdag gis kyang: sngon chad gzhan du bstan pa med: rgyal po'i thugs la stims shig gsungs: nag po rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rdzogs so: sye/mye/yye/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: :dbang chen khros pa khro bo'i rgyal: rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: thugs gter sbas pa lnga yod de: phyogs bzhi dbus kyi bsam yas kyi: mchod rten nag po lnga na yod: yang gter sbas pa 'di yin te: snying mdzod ga 'u nag po'i nang: gsang ba'i rgya bdun btab nas sbas: 'di la bsnyen pa sgrub pa dang: las sbyor brda rtags rim pa 'o: sye/mye/yye/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: dang po bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni: nag po thugs kyi sgrub thabs yin: de la bsnyen pa'i rtags thon nas: sgrub pa'i gzhung la 'jug par bya: dang po dur khrod dben gnas su: gtor ma btang zhing maṇḍal bya: bdud rtsi sman gyis chag chag gdab: ba su ta ste rgyu ma 'am: ras bal dag gis thig gdab ste: bcu drug cha rdzogs dang drug ni: phyed bsre de yi phyi ma bsre: gnyis bdun gnyis ni kha char bsres:

gsum dang bzhi pa rang sar bzhag: lnga dang brgyad ni dbus dor zhing: mtha' ma gnyis ni gdab par bya: de nas rim bskor gsum pa yin: mtha' nas bskor zhing de nang du: mu khyud ra ba bskor bar bya: de dbus gru gsum sgo can gdab: chos 'byung mthing nag zla gam dmar: mu khyud thod pa'i ra bar bya: gsum pa khyams ni phyogs bzhir mdog: shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang: ljang gur bya zhing sgo dang ni: rta babs la sogs spyi dang mthun: rdul tshon lha lngar rab gnas bya: bzhu brtul byas te mdzes par bri: de dbus mañdzi khri rkang steng: bum pa mtshan ldan bum rdzas bcas: gtsang ma'i chus dgang dar nag gi: mgul chings kha rgyan shing la bya: de steng spod kyis bran pa yi: gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs: rta mgo 'bar bas mtshan pa la: padma 'dab bzhi tshe ril bcas: gzhan yang mchod gtor sman raka dang: tshogs kyi mchod pas mdzes par bskor: dkyil 'khor tha ma mda' bzhi dang: gri bzhi phur pa bzhi dang ni: tshon skud sna lngas drwa bar dkris: bla bre yol ba la sogs pa: bkod pa du mas brgyan par bya: sngon du bya ba'i las rim mo: sye/mye/yye/: rgya rgya rgya: de nas sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum:1$0000250 dang po bgegs la mchod sbyin bya: rgyal chen gtor ma legs par gtang: bar chad med par gsol ba btab: de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni:

spyi dang mthun par byas nas ni: yan lag bcu yis tshogs chen gsag: tshad med bzhi yis rgyud sbyangs te: skad cig lhar gsal bka' bsgo ba: 1$0000300hūm̐: bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: mchod sbyin bzang pos tshims byos la: bdag gis sgrub pa ma thon bar: rang rang gnas su ci bder song: gal te log 'dren brtsam 'dod na: bdag nyid khro rgyal ting 'dzin gyis: lus sems 'bar ba'i ral gris gcod: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ phaṭa: ghṛhṇa ghṛhṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ā na ya ho: bha ga wan bidyā rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa:1$0000250 ces dpag tshad bye ba'i mthar bskrad la mtshams bcad pa ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: bdag nyid khro rgyal thugs srog hrī: nag po 'bar ba'i me 'od kyis: phyogs bcu bar mtshams med par khyab: thams cad mtshon cha me 'od 'bar: oṃ badzra dzwa la khaḍga rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa:1$0000250 mchod rdzas nus mthur brlab pa ni: 1$0000300oṃ badzra a mṛta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa:1$0000250 bdud rtsi gtor bas bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bsang: 1$0000300oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ:1$0000250 rang bzhin dag pa sngags kyi don bsgoms te: 1$0000300stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod:

stong gsum khyab pa'i nang du 'bru gsum las: thig le lnga ldan 'od du zhu ba yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang bar dmigs shing byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra ā lo ke= oṃ badzra gandhe= oṃ badzra nai widya= oṃ badzra shabda=1$0000250 gsum gsum sngags kyis nus pa bskyed par bya: sngon 'gro'i rim pa sye/mye/yye/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: gnyis pa bdag dang bum pa dkyil 'khor rnams: ting 'dzin gsum gyis sbyang zhing sgrub pa ni: 1$0000300hrī: gdod nas dmigs med dag pa'i dbyings nyid las: ma rtogs 'gro bar tshad med snying rjer shar: zung 'jug 'bar ba hrīḥyig mthing nag las: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ las mkha' rlung dang: khrag mtsho zhing chen sa gzhi keng rus ri: de steng raṃ las bskal pa'i me klong du: smug nag bhrūm̐ las dur khrod thod pa'i mkhar: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan: pha gu drwa phyed mda' yab pu shus mdzes: lha brgyad ka ba klu brgyad ka ba'i gdan: zhing lpags thog la rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phyang: khrag zhag zhing chung tsitta'i tog gis mdzes: sha dang khrag gi ri dang rgya mtshor 'khyil: gnam lcags gzer chen thod sbrul nyi zlas mdzes: chu srin ya them rus sbal ma them brjid:

zhing chen sgo logs sbrul nag sgo skyes btsug: nyi zla'i g.yag shing mi lpags lce khrab mdzes: phyi rol sha za khrag 'thung ro langs tshogs kyis bskor: ha ha drag pos gad sgra dir dir sgrog: me stag 'tshub ma dug shing nags tshal 'khrig: kang ka 'dab chags mang po 'phur zhing lding: sha za gcan gzan khyi spyang ngur sgra sgrog: de dbus mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i mtha': thod pa 'bar ba'i mu khyud zlum pos bskor: mdun dang g.yas g.yon zla gam khrag mtshor 'khyil: phyi nang kun gsal mkha' khyab gzhal yas gsal: dbus su bdud bzhi rigs lnga'i klu gdon dang: sa bdag klu 'bum gnyan khri nyi zla'i steng: 'dab brgyad padma dmar po ge sar steng: rang rig mthing nag hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: mchod dang sgrib sbyangs don gnyis yongs rdzogs pa'i: klu dang sa bdag gnyan dang sde brgyad rnams: gdug pa'i sems nyid tshar bcad stobs bsdus nas: 'bar ba'i me 'od 'phro ba'i hrīḥl thim: ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐: gsang sngags brjod pas hūm̐ nyid yongs su gyur: bdag nyid rta mgrin mthing nag phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum sdang mig bsgrad cing khrag ltar 'khrugs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: sma ra ag tshom me 'bar me stag 'phro: smin ma kham ser glog 'khyug khro gnyer g.yo: dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher: phyag g.yas gnas lcags ral gri phyogs bcur phyar:

dgra bgegs phyogs skyong log 'dren phye mar gtub: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pas dgra bgegs kyi: dbang po lnga sdom snying rtsa dmar nas 'dren: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs brkyang bskum bsgrad cing 'gying: sku stod zhing lpags g.yang gzhi rlon pa la: khrag gi rgyun babs sku yi na bzar gsol: sku smad stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can: steng nas dar nag 'jol ber phod can gsol: thod pa skam pos dbu la rnam par brgyan: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thod khang 'od du gsal: sbrul chen rigs bzhi sku yi rgyan du mdzes: khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang: lcags kyi ral gri 'bar ba'i ral pa yis: sku rgyab 'phyang zhing rting pa'i mthar thug 'khrugs: ral pa sprugs pa'i gseb nas khro chung gi: sprul pa grangs med phyogs bcu kun tu 'phro: rno dbal ral gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo 'khrig: dmar nag me dpung 'bar ba'i klong yangs nas: i ha ha yi sgra sgrog sku bong che: stong gsum gang ba dpal gyi sku ru bsgom: dpal chen rol pa phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis: thugs kar bsgreng ba'i rtse la gnam lcags kyi: sdig pa nag po mgo dgu ri rab tsam: rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med thog ltar 'phro: rgyal bsen sa bdag gdon tshogs za zhing 'dul: dpal gyi thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems: mthing nag gcer bu khro gtum ral pa can: rta mgo'i rtse nas rigs bdag 'od dpag med:

dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis lhung bzed bsnams: dar dmar chos gos 'od lnga'i dkyil na gsal: de yi thugs kar nyi steng ral gri 'bar: rtse la mthing nag hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor: ma yengs dran pa gsal brtan bar du bsgom: hrīḥlas hūm̐ 'phros klu gnyan sa bdag gi: steng du sku gsung thugs sprul khro bo ni: shar du yaksha me dbal 'jigs par byed: nag po phyag gnyis tho ba me dbal 'dzin: g.yas su gshin rje gshed nag 'jigs par byed: thod dbyug sdigs mdzub zhags pa me 'bar 'dzin: g.yon du stobs chen nag po gtun shing g.yas: sdigs mdzub me 'bar dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: phyogs bzhi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i gdan steng du: dri za grul bum klu dang gnod sbyin steng: hūm̐ bzhi yongs gyur shar du sku mdog dkar: rta mgrin rgyal po rdo rje ral gri g.yas: g.yon pa lcags kyus dri za'i srog rtsa 'dren: lho rtsibs yon tan rta mgrin gser gyi mdog: g.yas pa rin chen ral gri zhags pa g.yon: gshin rje'i srog 'ching nub rtsibs rta mgrin dmar: g.yas pa'i phyag na padma'i ral gri phyar: g.yon pas lcags sgrog klu gdon yan lag sdom: byang du phrin las rta mgrin sku mdog ljang: g.yas pas rgya gram ral gri glad la bskor: g.yon pa dril bus gnod sbyin spyi bo 'joms: kun kyang dur khrod chas dang ber nag gsol: rta mgo ljang zhur kun gyi gtsug na 'tsher:

rigs bzhi'i gdon tshogs dbang sdud zil gyis gnon: rang 'dra'i sprul pas 'jig rten khyab par byed: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbazhi: sgo bzhir klu gnyan sa bdag 'dre srin steng: 'phro 'dus klu gnyan sa bdag rgyal bsen bcom: yongs su gyur pa shar sgor rta gdong dkar: lcags kyu dang bcas g.yon pa rta dmag 'gyed: klu rnams rgyan 'chang rta zhal dag tu za: lho sgor phag gdong ser mo zhags pa g.yas: g.yon pas phag nag sprul pas gnyan rnams 'dul: nub sgor khyung gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog g.yas: g.yon pas khyung sprul sa bdag ma lus 'dul: byang sgor sbrul gdong ljang gu dril bu g.yas: g.yon pas sdig sbrul sprul pas rgyal bsen 'dul: kun kyang rang rang sprul pas khams gsum gang: gnas gsum 'khor lo padma rgya gram gyi: lte dbus zla steng 'bru gsum gsal bar blta: thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥhūm̐ la sogs pa'i: yi ge'i tshogs las 'od 'phros rgyal ba lnga: rigs kyi yum dang sems dpa' lcam dral dang: khro tshogs spyan drangs mkha' la bzhugs pa la: phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab: dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i chu rgyun dwangs ma yis: sku gang sgrib dag chu rgyun lud pa las: spyi gtsug rta skad thengs gsum 'tsher ba yis: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du sdud: klu dang rgyal bsen sa bdag tshar bcad cing:

sde brgyad bran khol nus mthu rdzogs pa'i dbang: yongs rdzogs thob pas che btsan rgyal por 1$0000250bsam: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas sgrub cing mchod bstod bzlas pa ni:1$0000300 gtso bo'i thugs srog hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros: rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rang 'dra dpag med spyan drangs bstim 1$0000250bya'i phyir: spos dang rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: 1$0000300hrī: dbyings nas spyan drangs dmigs med kyang: smon lam thugs rje'i mthu btsan phyir: sgyu ma'i tshul gyis khro rgyal tshogs: 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gru gsum e klong yangs pa nas: gnod sbyin nag po gshegs su gsol: dbang drag me rlung 'tshubs dkyil nas: klu bdud nag po gshegs= rno dbal drag po'i dbyings rum nas: khro chen sku gsum gshegs= 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng me klong nas: rigs bzhi'i khro tshogs gshegs= zang thal phyogs khyab 'tshubs dkyil nas: 'dul byed rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: klu bdud 'dul phyir rngams shing gshegs su gsol: sa bdag 'dul phyir 'bar bas gshegs= gnyan chen 'dul phyir khros pas gshegs= rgyal bsen 'dul phyir drag pos gshegs= sde brgyad 'dul phyir rol pas gshegs= mdze lhog 'dul phyir stobs kyis gshegs= smyo 'bog 'dul phyir dbyings kyis gshegs= khams gsum sdud phyir dbang gis gshegs=

hrī: gtsang sbyar rakta'i arghaṃ tshil chen spos: dbang po'i me tog dri chu sha tshil bshos: rkang gling rol mo'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa: dbang drag rol pa lha yi tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañtsa pū tsa khā hi: hrī: phyi nang dag pa sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i rdzas: reg bde dga' bde ye shes bzhi dang ldan: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dbang drag rol pa lha yi tshogs la 'bul: padma yo gi nī ā be sha ya pra be sha ya pū tsa ho:1$0000250 de nas bstod cing phrin las bcol ba ni: 1$0000300hrī: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: longs spyod rdzogs sku 'jigs pa'i tshul: 'bar khro rngam brjid dregs pa 'dul: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: 'gyur med mthing nag 'bar ba'i sku: zhal gcig chos kyi sku dang sbyor: phyag gnyis thabs shes phrin las mdzad: zhabs gnyis mtha' gnyis rnam par gnon: stobs chen rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: dug lnga rnam dag dur khrod rol: snang srid zil gnon dar nag gsol: gar dgu'i nyams kyis sku gsum sbyor: rol pa che la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag g.yas ral gris log 'dren 'dul: shes rab ral gri 'bar ba'i 'od: lcags kyus dgra bgegs snying nas 'dren: tshad med snying rje che la bstod: ye shes dbu rgyan rta skad 'tsher: log rtog 'khor ba zil gyis gnon: ma nor ma bcos chos kyi dbyings: rta skad rngam la phyag 'tshal bstod:

ral pa gzung 'dzin las grol zhing: khro chung bsam gtan ting 'dzin gsal: sprul pa'i chos las rnam rol ba: stong nyid snying rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: rngams pa'i zhal gyis srid gsum sbyor: rno dbal mche ba dkar po gtsigs: skye shi rtsad gcod dga' ba can: dgyes mdzad rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod: spyan gsum rnam par thar par ldan: khro gnyer 'jig tshogs ri bo 'joms: bskal pa'i me yis dug gsum 'joms: ye shes lnga rdzogs phyag 'tshal bstod: rmad byung 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas sprul: lhag bsam dad pas mchod par 'bul: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod:1$0000250 de nas lha nyid sems su blta: sems ni mkha' dang mtshungs par blta: mkha' mnyam lha dang gnyis med du: gsal ba sems kyi gding thob nas: 1$0000300thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥnag po: 'bar ba me ltar gsal ba las: gsang ba sngags kyi yi ge ni: bar snang bung ba lta bur bskor:1$0000250 klu 'dul gsang ba'i bsnyen pa ni: mi tshig bar ma chod du bzla: 1$0000300oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: nā ga raksha nag po ti pa tsa mā ra ya phaṭa:1$0000250 nyis 'bum grangs su bzlas pa yis: rtags mthong nus pa mos gus thob: yang na sum 'bum tshad du bzla: cho 'phrul sna tshogs gang yang 'byung: ya nga khu 'phrig bya ba spang: ting 'dzin ngar dang rab ldan pas:

'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur: de ni sgrub pa'i rim pa 'o: sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/: ྈྈྈ gsum pa las sbyor rim pa la: sngags dang rdzas dang sbyin sreg go: dang po sngags kyi rim pa ni: bsnyen sgrub drod thob nus rnyed nas: spyi dril dregs pa'i srog gcod sngags: gsal zhing ting 'dzin ma yengs bzla: 1$0000300yaksha kā la chen po gnod byed pho mo'i tsitta la rbad rbad: snying la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi yid la rbad rbad: yaksha kā la chen po sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen gyi tsitta zung zung: tsitta rmugs rmugs: tsitta gtubs gtubs: tsitta myog myog: tsitta thuṃ thuṃ ril ril: ya ya bhyo bhyo: klu dang rgyal bsen gyi srog rtsa chod chod: snying phyungs phyungs: gtubs gtubs: khaṃ rbad rbad: dum bur rbud rbud: nā ga rā tsa mā ra ya rbad sod: myog baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad ya:1$0000250 zhes pa zur ma nyams pa bzla: 1$0000300rtags ni sbal lcong sbrul bsad dang: rgya mtsho skam dang glang dmar bsad: nags tshal bsregs dang sdom sdig bsad: mkhar bshig shing gcod 'bu srin gsod: me 'bar lha khang bcom dang brdung: lder so rnying pa brdung pa dang: 'bag bshig ban de brdung dang gsod: bud med khyi nag byi la dang: khyi dkar la sogs brdung ngam bsad:

1$0000300hūm̐: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: dregs pa 'dul phyir rta mchog rol pa'i sku: gnod sbyin nag po klu dang rgyal bsen gshed: sha khrag brgyan pa bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di: rab gtum rngams pa khyod kyi zhal du khā hi: sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can: sprul pa nag po khyod kyi zhal du khā hi: gsung gi nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog: nag po kun rgyug khyod kyi zhal du khā hi: khro gnyer drag po glog stong 'gyu ba'i zhal: bdud 'dul nag po khyod kyi zhal du khā hi: che btsan yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa'i dpal: mthu stobs rtsal ldan nag po'i zhal du khā hi: dam tshig chen po'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul: rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:1$0000250 se/me/ye/: rgya/rgya/rgya/: dbang chen drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub dang las sbyor dus su bskul pa ni: 1$0000300hūm̐ hrīḥbhyo: 'phags pa'i rgyal po mgon po spyan ras gzigs: tshad med thugs rjes khro rgyal skur bstan pa: gar dbang rol pa khro bo kun gyi rje: rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud: phaṭa kyi 'brug sgras bdud bzhi'i klad pa 'gem: rta skad rngam sgras dregs pa las la bkol: gsung mchog rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos nyid spros bral rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings:

ye shes lnga rdzogs mtshan ma ma 'dres gsal: thabs mkhas thugs rje rgya cher rol pa'i sku: yon tan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'khor dang bcas: bka' yi pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: thugs dam dbang gis gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam tshig dbang gis rnal 'byor bdag cag skyongs: byang chub lam gyi bar chod myur du sgrol: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs dam sri thul: dug lnga log 'dren drag pos tshar gcod mdzod:1$0000250 sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: 1$0000300dbang chen drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gang byed kyang: rdzogs rim lta bas ma zin na: srin po'i rang gzugs bsgom pa ste: yi dwags gshin rje'i lus su skye: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku la sgrib: drag po sngags kyi rang sgra ni: stong pa'i mdangs su ma shes na: dmod tshig ngag rtsub 'khor ba'i rgyu: rdo rje'i gsung mchog don la sgrib: sems kyi rig rtsal lha yi sku: stong gsal chos skur ma shes na: mtshan ma'i rtog pa gzung 'dzin rgyu: mthar thug byang chub lam la sgrib: rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa'i mthu: stong nyid rgyu 'bras ma shes na: mtshan ma'i rdzas sbyor gnod 'tshe'i las: sangs rgyas byang chub lam la sgrib: sgrib bzhi dag pa'i thabs bstan pa: dang por stong nyid mtha' bral la:

yang dang yang du 'bad de bsgom: gnyis pa ma rtogs sems can la: ma ltar brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom: gsum pa thabs mkhas rten 'brel gyis: sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes bsgom: thun gcig lha yi sku la blta: sgrim dang klod pa yang yang bya: lha dang sems gnyis gcig gyur na: sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub: thun gcig kha sbyor rlung la bslab: thugs srog sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros: bsdus te snang sems gnyis med bsre: rtag tu bzlas brjod brtson gyur na: longs sku padma'i sems dpa' 'grub: thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul te: sems la rang bzhin med par blta: nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar: stong gsal rig pa rjen par bzhag: yang yang dran pas bskyangs gyur na: chos sku thugs kyi sems dpa' 'grub: dgra gdon sems kyi rnam rtog yin: rnam rtog rmi lam ji bzhin du: rtogs shing khong du chud par bya: ma 'gags sgyu ma'i rten 'brel gyis: lha sngags rdzas kyi rim par spyad: nad gdon zhi zhing tshe dbang rgyas: dbang du byed cing drag po 'grub: sna tshogs phrin las rdo rje'i sku: smon lam stobs kyis 'grub par 'gyur: 'di ni rmad byung gsang ba'i gter: yang dag bskyed rdzogs rdo rje'i rdzong: yang dag snying po'i gdams pa 'o: sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/: dbang chen drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: srung ba brgya stong bye ba'i snying po ni:

bhyo bdun sngags dang rdzas lnga dag dang bsdeb: 'di yi dus kyi mtha' mar drag po'i nad: kre kre ho zhes bya bas sa steng khyab: che btsun dmangs dang bcas pa'i srog 'joms tshe: blo la sngags 'chang lus la sngags rdzas brten: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag tu shor yang bzlog: rang la ci ri 'di la ri ba'i phyir: tshig tsam mi brjod snying rje'i sems kyis spyad: rin chen gser dang 'bru sman yon gyis bslu: padma bdag gis rgyud dang mkha' 'gro'i gsung: gcig tu bsdebs pas rims dug ma lus sel: 'di ni gces pa'i gdams pa mchog yin te: 'di las rab tu gces pa yod re kan: sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/: de la dang po sngags ni bhyo bhyo bdun gyis bcings: de las bsnon dang 'phri na na ra kan: oṃ dam bhyoḥyag bhyo 'bras gzer bhyo 'brum gzer bhyo: lhog gzer bhyo snying gzer bhyo rgyug gzer bhyo: dmar yams thams cad rakṣa rakṣa: kha bsgyur sham bu gang 'dod skabs dang sbyar: sngags them: sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/: rdzas lnga dag la gla rtsi shu dag nag: btsan dug sgog skya yung ba lnga yin te: legs par sngags la byis pa'i chu yis sbyang: yi ge dag la rim pa lnga ru byug: gla rtsi la sogs rigs lnga mkha' 'gro lnga: thub pa rigs gsum sgrol ma lnga ru mos: dri tsam tshor bas dpag tshad tsam du srung: nad dang gdon zlog nus pa rdzas them yin:

sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/: rab gnas sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad du bzla: gnod gdug che na mas bzlog nyer gcig bzla: rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas dril byas la: gang gi mgul lam dpung par btags gyur na: me dpung du mthong rims nad me 'bar yang: drag po'i char 'beb me dpung 'joms 'drar 'gyur: phreng gcig mgo can tshag med bris pa la: rdzas rnams byug cing dbus mtha' gang rung nas: dril bas srung dang nad gdon bzlog par 'gyur: gser gyi yon dang tshogs kyis bslu bar bya: sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/: rta mgrin nag po'i bsnyen sgrub man ngag las tshogs dang bcas pa: o rgyan gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis lha sras yab sras la gdams pa: gsang ba rtsis kyi yi ger sbas pa'o: dus mthar thug tshe nad gdon dmag dpung 'khrigs: tshe srog longs spyod me 'bar bsregs dang mtshungs: de dus dam 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal: nga yi smon lam mthu yis de 'phrad shog: skyes bu gza' dang rdo rje legs pas srungs shig: sya mya yya: rgya/rgya/rgya/:1$0000250 gar gyi dbang phyug ye shes rol pa rtsal gyis bsam yas dbu rtse mi 'gyur lha'i gzhal yas khang nas lcags pho sprel lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la gter nas phyungs te/ glang gi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bdun la yi ger phab pa*/ dam med la gsang ngo*// zur tsam yang mi bstan no// rgya rgya rgya/

ྈ dpal rta mgrin nag po'i mdze srung ba dang sbyin sreg gi las mtha' bzhugs/ sya mya yya: 1$0000300ྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcom ldan 'das dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang: glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu dang: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga sogs: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kyis: mi rnams tshe thung nad mang bas: de phyir o rgyan padma ngas: sde brgyad bran du bkol ba dang: gdug pa klu yi bla gshed 'di'i: mdze gso sgrub thabs nang du gsal: klu nad srung dang gso ba dang: srung ba'i 'khor lo bri thabs ni: gro ga ras sam shing shun la: rta mgrin nag po'i lto ba ru: 'khor lo rtsibs bcu mu khyud gnyis: lte bar klu bdud nad gdon dang: gnod byed srungs shig ming spel bri: lte ba'i mu khyud dag la ni: rta mgrin rtsa sngags srung tshogs bcas: rtsibs bcu dag la sngags 'di bkod: yaksha kā la chen po bdag 'chang ba po la gnod byed pho mo'i srog la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rus la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: rtsa rgyus la rbad rbad: yid la rbad rbad: yaksha kā la chen po gnod byed pho mo'i tsitta zung zung: tsitta rmugs rmugs: tsitta phyungs phyungs: tsitta gtubs gtubs: tsitta myog myog: tsitta thuṃ thuṃ: hril hril ya ya bhyo bhyo: yaksha kā la chen po gnod byed pho mo'i srog rtsa chod chod:

oṃ sarba bidyā hūm̐: spros bral stong pa nyid du bsam: de ni chos sku'i rab gnas yin: de nas rten 'brel brgya rtsa brjod: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bstim: de ni longs sku'i rab gnas yin: de nas rta mgrin rtsa sngags bzla: rta mgrin sku ru gyur par bsam: de ni sprul sku'i rab gnas yin: de nas dar nag khug mar dril: yon bdag khrus byas srung ba btags: bkra shis brjod cing smon lam gdab: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu 'dul: sa bdag klu gdon smos ci dgos: yon du gser zho re re yod: gang dgar byas na rang la gnod: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs don du gter du sbas: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bkru ba khrus kyi man ngag ni: maṇḍal steng du tshom bu bkod: bum pa dri bzang chu yis bkang: de steng thod pa dri chus bkang: dar nag bkab cing gzungs thag btag: mchod pa gtor tshogs gzhung bzhin bsham: bdag gi ting 'dzin ldan pa yis: mdun gyi bum pa dam rdzas la: lha tshogs bskyed bstim spro bsdu bya: oṃ ma hā kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: e ho shuddhe shuddhe: raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe: a a swā hā: de ltar gsal bar bzlas pa yis: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam: dus bzhir dri chus lus po bkru: de steng bum pa'i chu yis bkru:

bzang drug sbyar la khong du btang: nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu thub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dgra bgegs sreg pa'i las byed na: rta mgrin las byang gzhung bsrangs la: las gzhung spyi ltar tshogs mchod bya: tshogs kyi tha ma'i dus bab tshe: dug khrag byug pa'i maṇḍal steng: rta mgo lding ba'i sgyed pu gsum: de steng sla nga'i steng du ni: dmar nag dug sna sbyar la blug: mchod pa'i gtor tshogs rgyas par bsham: dgra bgegs liṅga brgya rtsa gnyis: bden stobs brjod cing 'gugs bstim bya: mgo ldog skyer ser kha la btags: dkyil 'khor mtha' la gzug par bya: skam thun mu zi sbang skam tshwa: lcags phye zangs phye dug sna tshogs: rlon thun chang la bul tog btab: drag po'i shing la mar khu bsku: bdag nyid dpal gyi chas su zhugs: ting 'dzin drag ngar ldan pa yis: rta mgrin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: myong ba dag dang ldan par bya: me nang rta mgrin 'khor bcas bskyed: las byang gzhung ltar spyan drangs shing: mchod bstod phrin las drag tu bskul: skam thun ling ga dag la brdeg: yang na drag po'i shing la bsreg: drag sngags sham la 'di ltar btag: dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ: me lce rta mgrin khro tshogs kyis: dgra bgegs dngos su gsol bar bsam: ling ga bsreg rdzas sha khrag 'bul: ting 'dzin gding dang ldan pa gces:

rjes gcod sgrub thabs bzhin du bya: gding med byas na rang nyid phung: shin tu gnyan pas gsang bar bya: dpal rta mgrin las phran srung sreg lag len: o rgyan bdag gis rta mchog rol pa gsang ba'i rgyud las btus nas: lha sras byang chub sems dpa' yab sras la gdams pa'o: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: zab rgya: kha thaṃ: so phag shi kha thaṃ:

1$0000250ྈ rta mgrin nag po'i dbang bskur dregs pa kun 'dul bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈྈ rta mchog dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur ye shes lam: 'di yi dngos grub dam pa yon tan thob: de phyir dur khrod lha khang dben gnas su: sa brtag sa bslang sa sbyang sa byin brlab: phyi nang mchod gtor thig tshon bum rdzas brlab: bdag nyid lhar bsgom dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bri: phyi nang rgyan dang sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams bkod: las kyi gzhung bsrang tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul: bzlas brjod grangs dang thun gyis mnyes par bya: mtshan ma mthong nas dbang dang dngos grub blang: de nas snod ldan slob ma khrus nas phyung: phyag 'tshal yon 'bul gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: kye: dbang chen rol pa dpal gyi dkyil 'khor dgongs: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems: bdag cag dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par 'tshal: byin rlabs ye shes rlan gyis bskyed du gsol: de ltar gsum brjod rdo rje slob dpon gyis: 'di skad brjod cing dam la bzhag par bya: kye ho: skal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs: bu khyod dad pas dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'jug 'dod dam tshig gsum bsrung zhing: dngos grub bsgrub la nan tan 'tshal: ces brjod dar gyis gdong bcings te: me tog dag kyang sbyin par bya: de nas yan lag bcu pa yis: tshogs gsag skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang:

rigs lnga'i dam tshig tshul bzhin du: rgyud las 'byung ba blang bar bya: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis: slob ma'i snying gar bdud rtsi blan: rdo rje yang ni bzhag byas te: sngags tshig 'di yis sems bskyed bya: oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi: oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ ho: siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ: de nas lus 'bul dri ba bya: bgegs bsal dam tshig gsang bar gdams: hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥyis nang du drang: dkyil 'khor bskor te shar du 'khod: pra we sha ya phaṭa ces pas: sgo dbye lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dam tshig la bzhag ye shes bstim: me tog gtor zhing lha dang sprad: mig dbye gsang ba'i ming yang btag: de rnams sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos: rgyud ltar mkhas pas shes par bya: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: dngos gzhi mnyes pa'i yon phul te: dbang don gsol ba gdab pa ni: byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la: ji ltar mchod chen bstsal pa ltar: bdag kyang mchod pa'i don gyi phyir: nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol: de ltar lan gsum gsol ba btab: thugs las sprul pa'i lha tshogs ni: rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: nam mkha' gang bar rab dmigs nas: slob bu lhar bskyed bum pa ni: spyi bo'i gnas lngar bzhag nas dbang: rta mgrin rgyal po rigs lngas bskur: hūm̐: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsang gsum las byung ba: khams gsum pas ni phyag bgyis phyir:

rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin: oṃ badzra buddha ratna padma karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: de nas dpal chen rol pa'i sku: rigs lnga'i rnam par shar ba gang: slob bu'i phung po lnga la bstim: hrī: ha ya grī wa rta mchog dpal: 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa po: khros pa'i nga ros srid gsum 'dul: dug lnga rnam 'joms dbang 'di longs: badzra buddha ratna padma karma ha ya grī wa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: lus kyi rtog tshogs lhar gsal bar bsam la: hrī: dpal gyi chas dang dur khrod rgyan: sna tshogs 'khrul 'khor rnam dag phyir: chags sdang rtog pa thams cad dag: chos rnams yongs rdzogs dbang 'di longs: shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: ngag la sngags kyi dbang bskur bas: drag pos khams gsum sgrol bar byed: 'brug ltar sgrog pa khro rgyal gsung: gsang sngags snying po'i dbang 'di longs: oṃ badzra kro ta ha ya grī wa hūm̐: ces brjod me tog sngags phreng sbyin: hrī: rta mgos rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i don: gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ldan: rta skad rngam pa'i dbang 'di longs: hrīḥgho ḍa ha ya grī wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: dbu rgyan rigs lnga ye shes lnga: bde gshegs kun dang mnyam par sbyor:

thod sbrul 'bar ba'i gzi 'bar ba: cod pan bzang po khyod kyis longs: ratna mu ku ṭa pa ṭa laṃ hrī: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: shes rab ye shes rdo rje'i mtshon: ral gri 'bar bas nyon mongs 'joms: 'jam dpal rab tu mi bzad pa: rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon 'di longs: badzra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: snying rje chen po shes rab thabs: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam las 'dren: byams chen mtshon cha thabs la mkhas: lcags kyu 'bar ba'i mtshon 'di longs: badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: rdo rje dril bu rig pa 'dzin: gnyis med ye shes rdo rje che: khams gsum las las rnam grol ba'i: rdo rje'i ming 'di khyod kyis longs: badzra nām a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid che: dar nag kun khyab rdo rje'i chas: dpal chen gos 'chang bdud rnams las: rnam par rgyal phyir rtags su sbyin: kā la wast+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa na: dbang drag lha rnams ma 'dres gsal: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: du ma ro gcig dbang 'di longs: badzra kā ya buddha ratna padma karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas ni:

sku mdog dmar gsal chags bral don gyi lha: bdud las rnam rgyal rig pa'i gsung dbyangs ldan: mi gnas ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra a mi dhe wa ud bha be a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: hrī: cod pan mi 'gyur man dhā ra: sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba: dbyings dang rig pa gnyis med pa'i: rtags kyi me tog 'di yang longs: oṃ badzra su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā: rol mo bya: spos 'bul lo: bum pa'i dbang ngo: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈ dbang chen drag po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas pas: rdzogs pa'i ye shes rim pa rgyud la blang bya'i phyir: dben par phyag btsal maṇḍal phul bya ste: thal sbyar gus pas gsol ba gdab pa ni: kye: sangs rgyas kun bdag rig pa 'dzin: dpa' bo padma he ru ka: gsang ba mchog gi ye shes de: slob dpon chen pos bdag la stsol: de skad lan gsum gsol ba gdab: thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rab sngags shing: slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag nas ni: lag tu gtad de 'thung du gzhug: rtsa khams kun khyab gsal stong gi: nyams myong dag la nan tan byas: ngag smin par byed pa gsang ba'i dbang ngo: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: dbang drag rol pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: rtsa rlung sngags kyi nus thob nas: dga' bzhi'i ye shes nyams myong phyir: dben par phyag btsal maṇḍal phul:

thal sbyar 'di ltar gsol ba btab: hrī: bde chen rol pa dbang gi rgyal: khrag 'thung yaksha he ru ka: bde ba'i ye shes rnyed dka' ba: bdag la yang dag bskyed du gsol: de ltar lan gsum gsol ba gdab: me long sindhu ras mtshan pa: gru gsum hrīḥyis brgyan pa ni: snying gar blan te 'di skad do: hrī: chos nyid bde ba chen po la: rtsal dang rol pa ngang gis shar: rang byung ye shes bde chen gyi: rang bzhin dag dang mnyam par sbyor: a ho ma hā su kha ho: kha sbyor rlung gis bde ba bsgom: yid smin par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: dbang drag ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yas bab bde bas rgyud gang ba'i: rnal 'byor pa yis ye shes lha: kha sbyor rlung gi sbyor ba yis: ral gcig yum gyi bde ba blang: mas brtan rta mgo'i rtser son pas: 'pho ba med pa'i bde chen po: der ni ma yengs shes rig gtad: hrī: chos nyid skye med nam mkha'i dngos: nam mkha' bde chen rol pas khyab: skye dang 'jig pa'i mtha' las 'das: dam tshig chen po'i dbang 'di longs: dzñā na pañtsa a a a: ma bcos skyon gsum bral ba yi: nam mkha'i lam la rtag gnas bya: thams cad dag par byed cing yongs su smin pa don dam bzhi pa'i dbang ngo: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas dpal gyi gtor ma dkyil 'khor gyi: lhar gsal gdab cing mchod dang bstod pa bya:

slob bu'i gtsug tu bzhag la 'di skad do: hrī: sku yi dbang bskur che btsan lhun rdzogs shing: gsung gi dbang bskur ngag gi nus par ldan: thugs kyi dbang bskur ye shes gsal dag rtogs: yon tan dbang bskur sa dang lam la gnas: phrin las dbang bskur 'gro don thams cad 'grub: thams cad yongs rdzogs dpal chen gtor ma'i dbang: yongs la mnga' bsgyur bdag nyid chen por shog: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur kā ya wā ka tsitta gu ṇa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ces spos dang rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas brjod: des ni mthu rtsal ma lus yongs rdzogs shing: rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ma lus 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rjes ni dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs te: gtang rag yon 'bul bsngo ba smon lam btab: bkra shis dga' ston tshogs kyi mchod par rol: lhag mchod gtong zhing dkyil 'khor mchod bstod bya: ye shes sems dpa' rang bzhin gnas su gshegs: dam tshig sems dpa' snying ga'i thig ler bsdu: thig le dmigs gtad dngos 'dzin dang bral ba'i: ngang las spyod lam rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya: rdul tshon chu 'am ri mtho'i rtse la gshegs: dbang gi dngos grub ma lus myur du thob: de phyir phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin don slad du: o rgyan padma thod phreng bdag nyid kyis: rta mchog rol pa drag po 'bar ba yi: rgyud las bkod de phyi rabs btsas su bzhag:

ma 'ongs dus kyi ye shes rol pa rtsal: de dang 'di 'phrad 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel: de phyir bsam yas dbus kyi yang mdzod du: bka' rgyas btab ste gter du sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'di ni kun gyi thun mong ma yin te: gces tshad mig la phangs tshad khong pa'i snying: gter kha du mar 'di dang mtshungs 'dra sbas: khyad par 'di 'dra sbas pa yod re kan: ma mgon dregs pa sde brgyad rnams la gtad: dus la babs tshe las can lag tu gtod: dus min 'don na srog chod sha la zo: khrag thungs rus pa choms shig dam tshig rnams: zhes gdams so: e ma bdag nyid sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas te: zhi bas 'dul phyir 'jig rten dbang phyug yin: drag pos 'dul phyir rta mgrin nag por bstan: de phyir o rgyan bdag dang gnyis su med: bsgrub sla myur mgyogs drag po gsang sgrub 'di: gdams so gtad do snying gi dkyil du bstims: sya mya yya: mant+ra gu hya kha thaṃ kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: rgya rgya rgya: : rgya/rgadzaṭa/: 'di la lo rgyus bsnyen pa sgrub pa dang: las sbyor sngags dang rtags bcas dang: spu gri nag po dgu sbyor dang: rdzas chen bco lnga'i sbyor ba dang: mchod gtor bstod bskul dang bcas so: bhyo bdun rdzas sngags srung ba dang: dbang bskur dregs pa kun 'dul te: chos sde bcu las mang nyung med: skal ldan 'gro ba'i dpal du shog: sya mya yya: rgya rgya rgya: gar gyi dbang phyug ye shes rol pa rtsal gyi gsang ba snying gi gter gcig ma'o// sya mya yya:rgya/rgya/rgya/
